symptom: `mxcli widget sync` changing a pluggable widget wrote every int32/int64 in its Type and Object back as a BSON double; a text box in the widget's slot got MaxLengthCode -1.0, which Mendix reads as unlimited (mx check CE6510), and a later 0-change sync did not repair it
cause: widgetToMap converted int32/int64 to float64 'so comparisons behave' and mapToWidgetDoc never converted back; TestWidgetRoundTripIsByteStable passed because its fixture stored the array markers as float64, the one width Mendix never uses for them
fix: Stored int32/int64 pass through the map form unchanged (AugmentTemplate never asserts a number's type); a stored double is tagged storedDouble so it stays a double; a bare float64 is a number the template pipeline made (constructed, or an exemplar cloned through JSON) and is written as int32, int64 past int32's range, as the create path does
insight: A byte-stable round-trip test proves nothing about a width its fixture never holds: build fixtures from the widths Studio Pro writes (int32 markers, an int64, a genuine double), and assert per-element BSON types after the operation, not just equality of a value. Settle it with mx check on a copy synced by the old binary (CE6510) against the fixed one (0 errors)
